name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 10 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 10a. Stresses that European structural funds are essential for the development of local communities in the Member States; enjoins the Council and the Commission to under no circumstances permit the use of these funds for other ends, such as arms purchases or to cover military expenses;
